dataset_roles.dataset_v1: development / model-selection set (used for model screening + prompt ablation; NOT held out).
dataset_roles.dataset_v2_synthetic: behavioral challenge / stress-test set (NOT real-world performance estimation).

v2_real.provenance_level: B (human_provenance_verified) for all; source_url_missing=true; not source_verified.
v2_real.human_reviewed_gt_coverage: 0 / 170 (GT annotation template ready; PENDING lightweight human adjudication of Strong/Partial/Missing)

v2_synthetic.separation_rule: synthetic metrics MUST NOT be merged with V2-Real; behavioral stress-test evidence only.

limitations: V2-Real is small (16 jobs) and provenance-level B (no source URLs); estimates carry wide uncertainty.
V2-Real human GT is not yet produced — template only; requires a lightweight human pass.
V2-Real taxonomy and Importance are heuristic drafts pending human confirmation; ambiguous Importance is a known limitation.
V2-Synthetic: only 9 of 65 probes are human-reviewed; 12 are selected-and-pending; the rest are scenario-derived, not exhaustively human-verified.
No exhaustive annotation was attempted — this is a credible AI Product Evaluation Case Study, not a production-grade benchmark.
